# Update an AI-ready specification file

Curated by Skill Harbor — from @github's awesome-copilot collection: a prompt skill that updates an existing specification file when requirements change or code evolves, keeping it structured for Generative AI consumption. Enforces precise, unambiguous language with requirements clearly distinguished from constraints and recommendations; an AI-friendly template with frontmatter (title, version, dates, owner, tags); numbered requirements, constraints and guidelines; interfaces and data contracts; Given-When-Then acceptance criteria; a test automation strategy section; rationale and context; dependencies and external integrations; examples and edge cases; and validation criteria. Honest caveats: this skill updates one spec file at a time (`${file}` placeholder) and assumes you already have a spec to revise — it doesn't bootstrap one from scratch; MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
